mentions.name: 100 Ideas from Books
mentions.description: A writing project on the author's site that documents one idea that shaped the writer's thinking from each book read over the years, whether or not the idea is the book's core theme, with a goal of documenting 100 ideas.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Over the years, I've read countless books. I started documenting one idea that shaped my thinking from each of these books. This idea may or may not be the core theme of the book.

Hope to document 100 ideas. Wish me luck.
